summary: Add dependency rules, bounded license classification and source observations
details: Evaluate bounded license expressions with exact license-exception pairing and reject missing license metadata or high, critical and unknown-severity advisories.
Require exact dependency and advisory/license scope, owner, reason, review reference and an unexpired review window of at most 90 days for exceptions.
Classify exact license bytes with the pinned existing release-scanner library, distinguish candidates from ambiguous or unknown results, and reject invalid batches without partial output.
Collect full application, QA and scanner Go graphs in isolated copies, verify downloaded sources, and snapshot root license bytes.
Verify npm registry archives against locked SHA-512 values before bounded inspection without extraction or package execution; preserve manifest declarations and text observations separately.
Bind snapshots to generator and manifest hashes, reject stale inputs and unsafe output paths, and clean up owned tool processes on failure or cancellation.
Pin Python QA wheels with SHA-256 hashes in isolated CI virtual environments, reject installed version/requirement drift and check the Python SDK's static standard-library import boundary.

Verify every pinned PyYAML distribution before bounded source/wheel metadata and license inspection, preserving cross-artifact declarations separately from text candidates without executing package code.

Catalog fixture coverage and pinned source transformations, preserve upstream notices, correct unsupported corpus source/license labels and check local identities plus read-only upstream byte equivalence.
Include fixture records and notice-text observations in the dependency snapshot, bind bounded inputs before provider work and reject source edits or newly unclassified files without overwriting them.

Configure bounded weekly minor/patch update groups for application and QA Go modules, marketing npm, pinned Python QA, Actions and both Dockerfiles, with separate unrestricted security groups and offline coverage checks.

Verify pinned Helm/oasdiff archive SHA-256 values before bounded binary/license inspection without extraction or execution, and verify the omitted Syft main-module source using the release recipe checksum pair and revision.

Discover pinned Action references from workflow/example YAML, verify public commit/tree/blob identities and scoped notices without execution, and preserve declared nested references with observed commit resolutions.

Bind standalone Cosign and disposable MinIO/client source pins to installation recipes, verify root and upstream Go graphs without installing commands, and preserve root manifest digests and merged graph origins.

Discover declared image sources, verify public manifest selections and scan exact registry digests or mapped local image IDs with qualified Syft; retain package/license observations while omitting environment values, labels and scanner paths, and leave operator image choices unresolved.

Generate source-bound maintenance review signals from selected version dates, public repository activity/status and npm deprecation metadata; preserve unknown states, separate fixture commit dates from payload identities, omit provider prose/contact fields and protect concurrent source/output edits.

Validate dependency-review comparison records before offline admission, preserve strict unknown-license and advisory-severity handling, merge cross-manifest advisories and reject conflicting metadata without claiming authenticated or complete provider coverage.

Read exact-source PR dependency observations through authenticated bounded GETs, reconstruct Git tree identities and require complete changed-file correspondence before exporting filtered provider rows. Normalize GitHub Go versions and support unversioned legacy removal URLs while retaining version requirements for additions.

Read immutable local or authenticated Git blobs with canonical byte/size/object checks, classify declared dependency input families, reject selected symlinks and report missing or unclassified sources. Verify current source catalog and selected manifest/fixture hashes without executing PR code or treating source coverage as dependency admission.

Build the bounded license helper from explicit trusted base Git sources and QA locks in a private credential-free environment, verify the exact compiler, unchanged source and module cache, and bind later classification to its executable digest. Current-target authorization and complete collector/admission integration remain separate.

Collect verified proposed Git inputs through trusted Python and a base-built classifier, separate actual generator hashes from proposed dependency-lock hashes, reject source/tooling drift and recheck the current PR context before output without executing proposed code.

Select actual dependency policy from current-target Git bytes, assess exact component/source/origin changes and query bounded exact-version OSV data. Keep unsupported or incomplete advisory coverage unknown, prevent head policy self-approval and retain a partial verdict until full scope and provider review integration exists.

Join authenticated GitHub and OSV findings without dropping severe or unmatched additions, verify exact-scope owner approval payloads for exceptions, retain expired waivers as inactive and orchestrate serial base/head collection with one trusted classifier. Recheck PR/review/UTC state and keep incomplete coverage non-passing.
Run rule and classifier regressions in documentation validation and document dependency selection/removal criteria.

compatibility.notes: Developer dependency tooling only; no production API, SDK or persistence contract changed. Source collection uses public registries and isolated scratch work. The license classifier is isolated in the QA tools module.

security: Reject malformed or oversized input, duplicate JSON keys, nonfinite numbers and unsupported metadata with errors that omit raw input. Rules have no network or subprocess effects; the classifier accepts digest-bound bytes over stdin without supplied-path or package-code execution.
limitations: EVY-1407 remains incomplete: operator deployment choices, combined trusted admission, live PR review, hosted update verification and release qualification are pending. Image observations cover selected package databases and Go binaries on Linux amd64, not complete artifact SBOMs or license approval. Maintenance signals are review candidates with explicit provider coverage gaps, not health or safety verdicts.
A review-link shape and synthetic policy tests do not prove approval or that real dependency changes are blocked by hosted CI.
